rationale: Adding an iMK801-analogue MOD modification to enable Fig 8 AP5 reproduction is specific to the deposited-code lineage. The from-scratch wave (t0052, t0053) does not include NMDA at all (AMPA-only excitation), so dendritic-NMDAR-block infrastructure is no longer on the project's critical path. Keep the suggestion active at medium priority for any future return to NMDA-bearing models.
